name: Top Hat and Tails
intro: The music. The stories. The people who bring them to life. This is Top Hat and Tails.
heroAlt: An ensemble dancing with umbrellas on stage
about: We are Top Hat and Tails, a musical theatre company. From the rehearsal room to the stage, we bring people together through a shared love of performing.
joinIntro: Interested in performing or helping behind the scenes? Tell us a little about yourself and how you would like to get involved.
